verdict.rationale:
WorkOS RBAC lets teams define custom roles and permissions at the organization/tenant level and enforce them via session JWTs, going beyond fixed built-in roles, but the documentation describes only role-based access control scoped to organizations — there is no evidence of relationship-based (ReBAC) modeling or resource-level/object-level policy authorization (e.g., per-document or per-record permissions).

missing for 10: relationship-based (ReBAC) authorization model, resource/object-level fine-grained policy enforcement beyond org-scoped roles, any policy engine (e.g., attribute- or context-based rules) evidence.
